ownership: Root selects exact inputs and dispatches the bounded stage. Maker starts no provider, database, browser or CPU action.
requiredRootInputs: The current authenticated tenant and scopes, resolved through the actual authorization boundary; no client-supplied trusted tenant.
One or more exact session IDs selected by root from its authorized TOC scope, at most five for this proposal; no invented IDs or verification state.
A concrete title and audience/purpose framed as guidance recorded in the selected sources, without promoting historical relative deadlines to current advice.
The explicitly authorized lkb_staging read-only connection and its exact LKB_ALLOW_STAGING=lkb_staging opt-in; no protected-production opt-in or implicit default.

The existing configured tenant-bound provider adapter, with a central hard cap of two underlying provider requests and a local content-safe usage sink. Root must dispatch this stage explicitly; authorization for another two-call stage is not additional budget.

composition.policyStore: apps/api/src/answer-policy/mongo-store.ts:createMongoAnswerPolicyStore using the named allowed staging database; do not call ensureAnswerPolicyIndexes
composition.policyLookup: apps/api/src/answer-policy/application.ts:lookupEffectivePolicy; its list/conflicts path reads current policies without queue/save/reconcile writes
composition.provider: Root's actual configured tenant-bound completion callback; no fixture-provider, fake response, additional credential or database-backed job log.
composition.reasonForMemoryDraftStore: The authorized staging scope is read-only. This exercises the actual create/get/export service and schema validator with real evidence and provider responses; it does not prove durable Mongo persistence or the full production composition.

sequence: Root records current relevant source/schema/guard hashes and the exact requested kind, title, purpose and selected source IDs; no secret key in receipts.

Root establishes the actual read-only reader and actual current policy service. Existing T054 corrections and T007 eligibility remain mandatory; do not replace approved claims with caller flags or synthetic verified copies.

Before provider dispatch, call actual evidenceFor for the exact root inputs. The existing bounds remain: at most200 candidate claims,4000 turns,100 citations,60000 quote characters; report actual sourceCoverage/policy/digest and canonical evidence. Empty, unverified, inaccessible, conflicting, over-bound or unsafe evidence refuses with zero provider calls.

Instantiate actual createOutputService with the same real reader/policy/provider and a fresh memory repository. Begin with kind faq. Call create once: generation plus separate grounding assessment, at most two actual underlying provider requests total, no fallback/retry/external retrieval. Revalidation is not called in this stage because it would consume another provider call.

Actual service rereads current sources/policy after both calls, checks the actual schema and assessed-content fingerprints, and persists only in process memory. Get and export the created draft at its current revision through the actual service; export rereads current evidence without another model call.

Root writes local QA draft JSON, canonical-evidence snapshot, Markdown artifact and exact bounded receipt. Record unknown/withheld/missing sections and exceptions honestly; do not force a successful artifact or fabricate elapsed time/token usage.

An independent reviewer compares every answer/factual clause and citation with the actual current quotations and attribution, checks historical qualifications and usefulness for the declared audience, and returns a concrete semantic decision. Model assessment alone is insufficient.
failureHandling: No currently eligible verified source: save a preflight refusal receipt, zero provider calls, leave actual-use gate open; newly indexed needs-review claims do not become trusted automatically.
No compatible actual current policy service or read-only credentials: stop before provider dispatch; do not substitute an invented active/none policy or bypass store guards.
Generation or grounding provider request fails, exceeds time/budget or returns invalid JSON/citations: no retry or replacement call; save exact failure and actual count.
Unsupported answers, current-source/policy drift or export refusal: retain truthful withheld/failure evidence; do not count the stage as useful accepted output.
Root must enforce the hard cap at underlying provider dispatch; two service calls alone do not constrain retries/fallbacks inside a provider chain.
laterSeparatelyDispatchedStages: Repeat this actual two-call recipe for report and meeting-brief only after separately authorized root dispatch; never claim three-kind usefulness from the single FAQ stage.

The existing explicit isolated real-Mongo integration harness still requires separately authorized writes to a fresh named test database, not read-only lkb_staging. Memory create/get/export cannot satisfy it.

Root ROUTE_FREEZE/compiler/global mounted API, independent real browser/citation clickthrough, actual reviewed source acceptance, T056 full-parent acceptance and Umesh acceptance remain distinct gates.
acceptanceLimit: A successful independently assessed stage establishes actual one-kind provider/evidence usefulness only. It does not close T058 or replace durable Mongo, full mounted UI/runtime, all-three-kind or human acceptance. No stage in this proposal has run.
